messages.subject: Project Cedar — Licence Agreement (Verrell mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Attached is our mark-up of the licence on behalf of Verrell. The principal changes are: running royalty reduced to 5%; cure period extended to 45 days; third-party-royalty deduction increased to 60%; and the liability cap reduced to £3m. We've left the field, territory and improvements regime untouched.

Happy to talk these through.

Deepa Kovac
Birchall Stone LLP

messages.subject: FW: Project Cedar — Licence Agreement (Verrell mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Verrell's mark-up is in. Their changes are commercial rather than structural — 5% royalty, 45-day cure, 60% stacking deduction, £3m cap. My instinct is we can give the 45-day cure and probably meet them around 5.5% on the rate, but hold the cap nearer £4m. I'll prepare our counter once you've spoken to Alice and Marcus on the rate.

James
